Karnataka Land Disputes and Temple Fund Cases Dominate Legal Coverage

Multiple Indian news outlets have reported on land-related disputes and legal challenges in Karnataka. These include allegations of altered land records concerning farmers' land and the allocation of stud farm land. Separately, the Madras High Court has addressed cases involving temple funds and amendments to rules governing Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) properties.
